title: Intro to Python: Build Something Real
subject: Computer Programming
description: A 12-week first programming course — every concept ends in a small program that does something.

milestones.title: Setup, print, and variables
milestones.description: Install Python, run your first program, store data in variables.
milestones.projectIdea: Write a program that introduces you to the computer — ask it questions about itself.

milestones.title: Strings and input
milestones.description: Text manipulation and talking to the user.
milestones.projectIdea: Mad Libs generator: collect words, produce a ridiculous story.
milestones.resourceHint: Automate the Boring Stuff, chapters 1-2 (free online)

milestones.title: Conditionals
milestones.projectIdea: Decision helper: a program that asks questions and recommends dinner, movies, or adventures.

milestones.title: Loops
milestones.projectIdea: Number guessing game with a loop, hints, and a score counter.

milestones.title: Lists
milestones.description: Collections of things: storing, sorting, and searching.
milestones.projectIdea: Quiz maker: store questions in a list, quiz a family member, grade their answers.

milestones.title: Functions
milestones.description: Reusable blocks: inputs, outputs, and clean code.
milestones.projectIdea: Refactor your quiz into functions and add a high-score board saved to a file.

milestones.title: Dictionaries
milestones.description: Key-value pairs and looking things up fast.
milestones.projectIdea: Contact book or creature codex: add, search, and list entries.

milestones.title: Final project
milestones.description: Design and build a program of your own, start to finish.
milestones.projectIdea: Choose it: a text adventure, a flashcard trainer, a budget tracker — plan it, build it, demo it.
